specification.no: No event satisfying the YES contract within its specified window.
specification.resolution_source: Kalshi final settlement for KXSPACEXSTARSHIP-14-26OCT01 using frozen contract terms and designated underlying sources; preserve later rule changes separately.
specification.text: SpaceX Starship Flight 14 launch before October 1, 2026 (launch-site local date)?
specification.void: Record void/disputed if Kalshi cancels, returns a nonbinary settlement, or rule interpretation prevents matching the frozen contract. Preserve history.
specification.yes: If SpaceX launches Starship flight test number 14 After issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. Launch means liftoff with sustained ascent; scrubs and static fires do not count, while a failure after liftoff still counts. Only flight test 14 after market issuance counts. The calendar boundary is launch-site local time; the numeric deadline uses America/Chicago for Starbase and must be flagged if the launch site differs.
